    START SMALL

    Make room
    for a daily habit.

    First, let’s check that the essentials work on your iPhone.

    1. Add to your Home Screen

      Open this site in Safari, use Share → Add to Home Screen, then launch it from its new icon. Import your files there, since storage may differ from the Safari tab.

    2. Import your materials

      In My materials, choose your scanned PDF and a few recordings. Wait until every file shows “Stored”. Filenames such as L001-LESSON.mp3 or Lesson 1.mp3 automatically connect recordings to lessons. Start with a small sample before importing your whole collection.

    3. Set your place

      Choose your lesson and move to a study step. Its matched recording loads automatically. Look for “Saved on device”. If a filename cannot be matched, you can choose its recording manually.

    4. Try it offline

      Wait for “App available offline”, close the app, enable Airplane Mode, and reopen it. Check your saved lesson, play audio, and open the book. Repeat after restarting your iPhone.

    What this test tells us

    If your materials and progress survive reopening offline, we can build the lesson page mapping and sentence practice next. This cannot guarantee that iOS will retain the files indefinitely.
